process.form: frequency-dependent Moran, birth-death, one replacement per step
process.fitness: exponential, f = exp(beta * payoff) — positive for any payoff, so the matrix needs no shift
process.self_interaction: excluded; payoffs use the M-1 denominator

fixation.method: closed form for the 1-D birth-death chain
fixation.numerics: accumulated in LOG space — the gamma products underflow to zero for moderate beta*M, which would report a rare fixation as impossible

stationary.limit: small-mutation limit: each mutation fixates or dies before the next arrives, so the population is a monoculture almost always
stationary.stable_threshold: mass >= 1.5 / N (the raw distribution is reported too, so another cut can be applied)
